items.title: Эспер о Nvidia, Иране и Украине
items.original_title: Esper on Nvidia, Iran and Ukraine
items.rss_summary: Former Defense Secretary Mark Esper discusses the national security questions surrounding Nvidia and China, the Trump administration’s options in Iran and the widening war in Ukraine. Esper, managing partner at Red Cell Partners, says economic pressure on Tehran needs more time to work and calls for a longer-term strategy if the US returns to military action. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

items.original_title: Nvidia’s Huang To Face Scrutiny on Capitol Hill
items.rss_summary: "Balance of Power" focuses on the intersection of politics and global business. On today's show, Rep. Greg Stanton, a Democrat from Arizona who serves on the House Foreign Affairs and China Select committees, says Nvidia’s board should testify as Congress investigates Jensen Huang and the company. Former Defense Secretary Mark Esper discusses the national security questions surrounding Nvidia and China, the Trump administration’s options in Iran and the widening war in Ukraine. California Attorn
